Privacy policy.

Short, because this site does very little with your data.

Last updated [date]. Review by counsel pending. [legal review pending]

What we collect

The only personal information this website collects is what you type into the consultation form: your name, phone number, email address, property type and message. Nothing is collected until you press "Send request".

How it is sent and stored

Form submissions are delivered to us by Web3Forms, a form-to-email service, and arrive in our inbox. We keep them for as long as we are in conversation with you about your building, and delete them on request.

Cookies and analytics

This site sets no cookies and runs no analytics or advertising scripts. If that changes, this page will say so first.

Third parties

We do not sell or share your information. It is used only to respond to your request and, if you become a client, to do the work you hired us for.

Your choices
